basic_info.name: Sarvam AI Suite (Sarvam-1/2, Bulbul TTS, Mayura)
basic_info.pipeline_stage: Multi-stage Foundation AI Suite spanning LLM Reasoning & Dialogue Personalization (Sarvam-1 / Sarvam-2), Conversational Machine Translation & Tenglish Transliteration (Mayura / Sarvam-Translate), Native Indic Speech Synthesis & Voice Cloning (Bulbul v3 / Bulbul v4 Flash & Voice Cloning API), and Speech Recognition / Multimodal Audio Understanding (Saaras STT / Shuka v1).
basic_info.license_and_availability: Hybrid Open-Weights and Commercial SaaS Model. Open-weights research models: Sarvam-1 (2B parameter base LLM) is released on Hugging Face under the Sarvam Non-Commercial Research License (permitting academic exploration and fine-tuning, commercial use requires private enterprise licensing); Shuka v1 (audio-LLM on Llama 3 8B) is open-source; Sarvam-Translate (Gemma 3 fine-tune) is open-weights. Commercial Cloud APIs: Bulbul TTS (priced at ₹3.00 per 1,000 characters for standard and streaming synthesis), Saaras STT (priced at ₹30/hour base, ₹45/hour with speaker diarization), Mayura translation and transliteration (usage-based character pricing), and Voice Cloning API (POST /voices/create and POST /voices/clone). New accounts receive ₹100 in initial free testing credits with non-expiring pay-as-you-go top-ups.
basic_info.developer_or_organization: Sarvam AI (founded in August 2023 by Dr. Pratyush Kumar and Dr. Vivek Raghavan, spun out from IIT Madras's AI4Bharat research ecosystem), headquartered in Bengaluru, India. Recognized partner under the Government of India's IndiaAI Mission.

technical_features.telugu_script_and_tenglish_support: Exceptional native script and transliterated (Tenglish) capability across text and audio modalities. Sarvam-1 features an Indic-specialized tokenizer yielding a fertility rate of 1.4–2.1 tokens per word for Telugu (compared to 4.5–8.0 tokens/word in standard multilingual models like Llama 3 or Mistral), significantly improving generation speed, context window density, and computational efficiency for Telugu unicode text. Mayura translation incorporates explicit script control flags allowing deterministic output formatting in either standard Telugu script (Unicode te-IN) or Romanized transliterated Telugu ('Tenglish' / Latin script). Bulbul TTS natively parses both Telugu Unicode and Romanized Tenglish phonemes, correctly assigning Dravidian phonetic rules to Latin-script transliterations and avoiding the anglicized mispronunciation common in Western TTS systems.
technical_features.regional_dialect_and_localization_handli: Trained on massive synthetic and curated conversational Indic audio and text corpora, reflecting authentic colloquial speech patterns across urban and semi-urban Telugu speakers. Mayura provides discrete style selection modes ('Formal', 'Modern Colloquial', 'Classic Colloquial', and 'Code-Mixed'), making it well-suited for informal colloquial dialog (e.g., natural usage of 'enti sangati', 'vastunnava', and colloquial contractions). The models effectively bridge standard Coastal Andhra administrative Telugu and Telangana colloquialisms. However, ultra-localized rural Rayalaseema idioms or niche sub-regional sociolects lack explicit fine-grained token controls and require persona-based system prompting or in-context few-shot examples for consistent elicitation.
technical_features.personalization_and_user_adaptation: Two-pronged adaptation mechanism covering acoustic identity and textual persona. (1) Acoustic Persona Adaptation: Sarvam's Voice Cloning API provides an instant enrollment pathway where developers upload 10–30 seconds of clean reference speech from a target speaker via 'POST /voices/create'. The system processes speaker embeddings and returns a persistent 'voice_id'. Subsequent synthesis calls via 'POST /voices/clone' recreate the user's specific vocal identity across Telugu, Tenglish, or other Indic languages. (2) Textual Persona Adaptation: Sarvam-1 (2B) supports parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT/LoRA) on user-specific chat transcripts to adopt idiosyncratic catchphrases, humor, and colloquial habits. In API environments, Mayura's style parameters and few-shot system instructions guide conversational outputs toward personal tone preferences.
technical_features.voice_cloning_and_acoustic_fidelity: Bulbul's Voice Cloning architecture utilizes an Indic-specialized neural acoustic backbone conditioned on reference speaker embeddings. It requires only 10 to 30 seconds of clean, single-speaker reference audio (16kHz or 24kHz WAV/MP3) with minimal background noise. The cloning engine maintains strong vocal similarity, timbre preservation, and speaker characteristics while preserving native Indic phonology—preventing foreign American or British accent artifacts when speaking Telugu. Furthermore, the cross-lingual cloning feature enables a voice enrolled using an English or Hindi reference clip to fluently articulate Telugu and Tenglish without losing speaker identity or prosodic authenticity.
technical_features.code_switching_stability: Industry-leading stability for mid-sentence Telugu-English code-switching (Tenglish). Unlike conventional speech synthesisers that trigger audible pitch artifacts, phonetic glitches, or sudden timbre shifts when encountering Latin characters or English loanwords mid-sentence, Bulbul v3 / Bulbul v4 Flash treats mixed-language utterances (e.g., 'Nenu repu office ki commute avvali, meeting schedule chesara?') as first-class citizens. Mayura translation similarly respects domain loanwords, technical jargon, and corporate slang without forcing unnatural literal translations into archaic Telugu vocabulary.
technical_features.phonetic_and_orthographic_normalization: Advanced Indic front-end text normalizer tailored to handle irregular phonetic orthography and social media chat conventions. Accurately disambiguates retroflex consonants (ట, ఠ, డ, ఢ, ణ), dental stops (త, థ, ద, ధ, న), and aspirates. Correctly manages terminal vowel elongations frequently seen in casual digital messaging (e.g., 'avunaaaa', 'enti raaa') by mapping elongated vowel repetitions to natural prosodic emphasis rather than spelling errors. Crucially for Dravidian phonology, it maintains terminal vowels and avoids inappropriate Hindi-style schwa deletion (schwa syncope), ensuring proper Telugu syllable structure.

performance_metrics.inference_latency_and_streaming: Bulbul v3 and Bulbul v4 Flash offer low-latency WebSocket streaming endpoints engineered for real-time conversational voice agents, advertising sub-250ms Time-to-First-Audio (TTFA) / first-chunk latency over streaming connections. In production deployments integrated with voice-orchestration pipelines (such as Pipecat or Bolna), end-to-end user-perceived voice-to-voice turn latencies typically range between 400ms and 900ms depending on network proximity to Sarvam's India data centers. Real-Time Factor (RTF) is significantly below 0.15 on GPU inference infrastructure. Standard REST endpoints are available for batch generation, video localization, and offline audio dubbing.
performance_metrics.acoustic_naturalness_and_expressiveness: Evaluated with high subjective naturalness, yielding conversational cadence and emotional inflection superior to generic multilingual engines. Pre-trained catalog voices (e.g., Aditya, Priya, Kavya, Roopa) achieve Mean Opinion Score (MOS) ratings exceeding 4.1–4.3, with zero-shot cloned voices achieving approximately 3.9–4.1 MOS [uncertain]. The API supports granular prosodic adjustments including pace (0.5x to 2.0x playback rate) and temperature parameters to modulate expressive spontaneity and conversational liveliness.
performance_metrics.transcription_and_translation_accuracy: Sarvam-1 demonstrates superior performance on Indic benchmarks relative to parameter count, scoring 86.11% accuracy on Indic TriviaQA (outperforming Llama 3.1 8B at 61.47%) and competitive zero-shot scores on Indic MMLU (38.2–44.4) and IndicGenBench. Mayura translation delivers robust conversational translation and code-mixing accuracy, typically achieving chrF++ scores between 55.0 and 65.0 on colloquial Indic language pairs [uncertain]. Saaras STT achieves low Word Error Rate (WER) across multi-accented Indian English and regional Telugu speech.

market_positioning.end_to_end_vs_modular_role: Dual-faceted architecture. Operates both as a turnkey sovereign voice AI platform (via Sarvam Studio, Saarathi, and agent development frameworks) and as an ensemble of composable, modular cloud microservices (Bulbul TTS, Voice Cloning, Saaras STT, Mayura Translation, and Sarvam-1 LLM). Within a custom localized pipeline, developers can either adopt the entire Sarvam stack end-to-end or plug individual modules (such as Mayura for Tenglish translation and Bulbul for voice-cloned speech synthesis) into external architectures incorporating open-source components like AI4Bharat IndicTrans2 or self-hosted Whisper models.
market_positioning.strengths_and_limitations: Key Strengths: (1) Superior Indic token efficiency (1.4–2.1 tokens/word) optimizing Telugu inference costs and context utilization; (2) Production-grade Romanized Tenglish script synthesis and bidirectional transliteration via Mayura; (3) Native Dravidian phonetic fidelity in Bulbul without foreign Western accents; (4) Rapid, low-friction voice cloning from 10–30s audio clips; (5) Highly affordable API pricing (₹3 per 1k characters TTS, ₹30/hour STT). Key Limitations: (1) Bulbul TTS and Voice Cloning models are proprietary cloud APIs with closed weights (cannot be self-hosted on offline edge devices); (2) Sarvam-1 open weights carry a non-commercial research license restricting commercial self-hosting without enterprise contracts; (3) Highly niche rural dialects (e.g., Rayalaseema rural slang) require explicit few-shot conditioning; (4) Pre-built catalog voice selection (35+ voices) is smaller than global services like ElevenLabs.
market_positioning.recommended_implementation_recipe:
Turnkey Integration Blueprint for Personalized Telugu/Tenglish Localization:
1. Acoustic Persona Enrollment: Collect a clean 20-second reference audio recording of the user speaking English, Telugu, or Hindi. Call 'POST https://api.sarvam.ai/voices/create' with the audio payload to generate a persistent 'voice_id' and store it in the user profile database.
2. Persona & Dialect Transcreation: Route incoming source text or conversational turns through Mayura Translation API ('POST https://api.sarvam.ai/translate') with 'target_language_code': 'te-IN', 'mode': 'modern-colloquial', and 'script': 'roman' to generate fluent Tenglish (or 'script': 'native' for Telugu Unicode). For deep personality conditioning, use Sarvam-1 with in-context persona prompts to inject user catchphrases.
3. Voice-Cloned Synthesis: Stream the generated Tenglish/Telugu text to Bulbul Voice Cloning API ('POST https://api.sarvam.ai/voices/clone' or via WebSocket) with the user's 'voice_id', 'target_language_code': 'te-IN', and 'pace': 1.0.
4. Edge Normalization Fallback: Pre-process non-standard brand names, acronyms, and social media slang using lightweight regex rules or IndicXlit transliteration prior to TTS ingestion to guarantee 100% phonetic pronunciation fidelity.
